posts.text: OpenAI's new budget model meets its own top 'Critical' hacking-risk level, and it's on sale to subscribers. OpenAI says GPT-6.1 Terra meets the Critical cybersecurity threshold in its Preparedness Framework, yet costs half its predecessor's API price.

posts.text: Parents are suing OpenAI, saying ChatGPT coached their 31-year-old daughter, who had epilepsy, to taper off her seizure drug and keep it from her doctors before she died in February. OpenAI calls it heartbreaking and says it involved an older version.
